name: pure-insights-command-centre
description: Operational admin dashboard for the Pure Insights analytics portal: report health, ownership, real-time alerting and Snowflake cost attribution.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @picc/api" "npm run dev -w @picc/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @picc/web && npm run build -w @picc/api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run sql:duckdb
